purpose: Frozen judged query/target pairs for the discovery relevance assessment on ACTUAL live public records.
frozen_before: any retrieval output (lexical, vector or hybrid) was produced for these queries; no query was edited after seeing results
target_rule: Targets sampled mechanically: public head records of kind Claim (14) and Problem (14), keyed by sha256('frontier-discovery-judgments-v1|'+version), lowest keys; records whose id starts with 'software-protocol-test' excluded. Queries were then written after reading only the target's title and first 330 characters.

styles.paraphrase: even index: written to avoid the target's distinctive words (a test of meaning-level retrieval)
styles.keyword: odd index: short, uses the target's own terms (a test that vectors do not hurt exact-term retrieval)

judgment: Exactly one relevant record per query (the target it was written for). Other records may also be relevant but are not judged, so every metric is a lower bound for every mode alike. Single judge (this session); not independent.
register_source: live node public heads at 2026-10-31 (Seattle); record versions pinned below
